name: Mossy Ruins Field
entryMessage: Moss creeps over the ancient stones...

types.message: The old stones lent weight to the attack!
The damp stone smothered the flames...

surf.message: The ruins soaked up the water...

transition.message: The ruins sank into the marsh!

typeComposition.message: Moss clung to the stone attack!

actions.message: {1} soaked up the moss and recovered!

rules.source: Mossy_Ruins_Field.md: Moss (grounded Grass Pokémon recover 1/16 each turn)

seed.message: The Telluric Seed's moss wrapped around {1}!

notes.summary: A worked example of a custom field: moss-covered ruins where Grass and Rock hit harder and Fire is smothered.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Grass moves are 1.3× stronger. Physical Rock moves are 1.2× stronger. Fire moves are 0.8× as strong.
Power Whip is 1.5× stronger. Rock moves also count as Grass for type effectiveness (no extra same-type bonus).
Mimicry, Camouflage and Terrain Pulse use the Rock type. Nature Power becomes Power Whip.

sections.heading: Moss
lines: Grounded Grass Pokémon recover 1/16 of their HP each turn.
Repeatedly using Surf floods the ruins and turns the field into a swamp.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: The Telluric Seed raises Defense by 1 stage.
